independent_assessment.applicability_limit: Only one small, fully specified four-exporter migration per variant was observed. Agents may reasonably classify this as a small established transformation. Absence of a pilot here does not establish that a general pilot-before-expansion instruction is ineffective for broad or uncertain work. No causal improvement or regression can be claimed from this pair.

decision: Reject candidate. No observed pilot-before-expansion in either arm. Small fully specified migration limits applicability.
